title: Learning analytics
description: Private Learning tab on Analytics: time, Cognition streak, and email opt-ins. Not author revenue.
content:
The Learning tab on Analytics is private. It is about your time and streak, not how your hubs convert.

Primary action: Open Analytics

What you see

  • Learning time and recent activity
  • Cognition streak for the week
  • Links into Communication settings for learning emails

Author vs Learning

If you also create hubs, Analytics has an Author tab for views, members, purchasers, Aura, and saves. Guide: Analytics for creators. Stripe still holds payouts and dollar detail.

What’s next

  • Cognition streak
  • Browse Library
  • Analytics for creators

Open Analytics →
